summary.text: Suzanne Spurgeon is the Republican candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 82, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where incumbent William Clyburn Sr. (D) is also on the ballot.
She ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Suzanne Spurgeon, who is also known as Suzy, was the Republican nominee for District 82 in 2024.
Incumbent William Clyburn Sr. (D) defeated her in the November 5, 2024 general election, 53.9% to 46.1%.
Her Republican primary for the 2026 race, scheduled for June 9, 2026, was canceled, and she advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.
